prompts.title: Inspection workspace
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity desktop product interface concept for 3Lens, developer tools for three.js. Create a polished straight-on flat screen design, wide landscape aspect ratio, crisp readable UI typography, practical engineering-tool density. This is a concept design, not a claim of implemented features. Cohesive visual system based on the current 3Lens interface: near-black graphite workspace, slate panels, fine gray borders, restrained teal selection/accent, off-white text, amber ESTIMATED and gray UNAVAILABLE labels, red reserved for regressions; compact sans-serif labels and monospaced identifiers. No decorative gradients, no marketing hero, no browser/device mockup, no perspective, no glossy futurism. Product hierarchy: slim top session/context bar, narrow tool rail, Inspector as persistent shared selection, and a time-range strip. Every cost must visibly connect to a named entity and its resource or pass chain. Use EXACT / ESTIMATED / UNAVAILABLE badges and explanatory text. Live and saved-trace modes share the same shell. VERY IMPORTANT: design ONLY developer-tool UI and interaction affordances. Do not create, model, illustrate, render, redesign or beautify any scene objects. If a viewport is needed, show a completely empty neutral charcoal rectangle labeled 'Existing application viewport' with a subtle border. No cubes, spheres, torus, meshes, characters, environments or 3D models anywhere, including thumbnails. UI tree rows representing entities are allowed as text. Use realistic short English labels; prioritize legibility over filling every corner. Primary request: the flagship live inspection workspace. Strong product composition with top wordmark '3Lens', session 'Local session', 'LIVE', context dropdown 'Main renderer', mode 'STANDARD', actions 'Record', 'Export trace', 'Open trace'. Tool rail labels Inspect, Performance, Memory, Changes, Shaders. Selected Inspect. Left entity tree with text rows Scene, MainCube selected, Floor, KeyLight, Main camera, and a search field. Large middle empty existing-application viewport taking 43% width, containing only a small floating 'Pick entity' toolbar and a selection breadcrumb below. Right inspector organized into 'Identity', 'Relationships', 'Cost', 'Changes', 'Actions': selected MainCube and stable ID main:object3d:82a; graph relationships MainCube -> StandardMaterial -> albedo.png as small flat text chips; geometry estimate '48 KB ESTIMATED', 'GPU time UNAVAILABLE', 'No per-entity timer captured'; commands 'Follow material', 'Set baseline', 'Compare selection'. Bottom narrow event timeline with frame selection 1240 and event rows. Include small status 'Selected entity is shared across tools'. Make the interface immediately understandable, with restrained visual hierarchy and generous enough panel widths. No actual scene visuals.
